topic: 5 side hustles a college student can start with just a laptop
angle: Not dropshipping. Not day trading. Real skills that pay while you study.
hook: 5 side hustles a college student can start this weekend with just a laptop
caption:
Every college student wants a side hustle. Most reels push dropshipping or crypto. Both are bad ideas at 20. These five build real skills, pay real money, and look great on a resume when you graduate. Pick one and go deep for three months. Which one would you try first?

#ProfitPrompts #EarningStrategies #SideHustle #Freelance #PassiveIncome #MakeMoneyOnline #AIhustle #IndiaFreelancer

slides.text: 5 side hustles a college student can start this weekend with just a laptop
You need a laptop and two hours a day. That is the entry cost.

items.title: Notion templates
items.desc: Build once. Sell forever on Gumroad. Rs 500-2000 each.

items.title: Freelance writing
items.desc: Fiverr + Upwork. Rs 3000 per article by month three.

items.title: AI prompt packs
items.desc: Curate 50 prompts for a niche. Sell for Rs 300.

items.title: YouTube tutorials
items.desc: Screen-record what you already learned in class.

items.title: Local social media
items.desc: One local business, Rs 15K/month, one client to start.

slides.caption: what an average college student can hit by month 3 on any one of these

slides.title: Pick ONE and give it 90 days
slides.body: The problem is not the hustle. It is switching between hustles every two weeks. Pick one. Ship weekly. Reassess in 90 days.

slides.text: The compounding is real. Skills stack. A student writing on Fiverr today is a copywriter earning Rs 1L/month at 25.
Save this. Pick your one this weekend and reply with which one you picked.
